justification: The assessment targets the torsion-duality criterion, whereas ground truth targets the Gray-image converse. The assessment’s separate flaw is genuine: C={00,11,22,33} has Tor_0(C)=Tor_1(C)={00,11}, which is binary self-dual, but 11·11=2 modulo 4, so C is not quaternary self-dual. The shared witness refutes both distinct claims.
